title: A few questions before your new website goes live
intro: We rebuilt blakeandboky.com in code, matched to the current design. Along the way we found a handful of things only you can answer. It takes about 8 minutes, your answers save as you go, and you can skip anything you are unsure about.

questions.q: Are these the right figures for the counters on the home page?
questions.ctx: 78+ exhibitions · 12 collections · 350+ sculptures made · 29 countries exhibited in
questions.help: On the old site the counters never stopped counting, so we took these numbers from its settings.

questions.q: What are Boky's own exhibition countries and figures?
questions.help: Boky's biography currently shows exactly the same countries and numbers as Blake's (4 major collections, 13 countries). If hers are different, list them here.
questions.placeholder: Countries, number of collections, anything else to show

questions.q: How should this sentence in Boky's timeline end?
questions.ctx: 1991 to 1996: ...exploring photography, film and the art market. Working between

options: Yes, that is the whole entry

questions.q: How does the Spirit Collection introduction continue?
questions.ctx: The collaborative process started in 2011 with Angel NUMBER 1 ... and continued into
questions.help: The old page ended in an unfinished note ("ect;;;"), so the text now stops after Angel NUMBER 1.

questions.q: Where should the Rethink Collection card lead?
questions.help: There is no Rethink page yet. The old card opened Boky's In Lucem page by mistake; it now opens Blake's "in preparation" page.
options: Hide the card until a Rethink page exists

questions.q: When was each news article published?
questions.help: All five articles show 24 Nov 2025 at the moment. Leave a field empty to keep that date.

fields.label: Invoco Te Divina Stella / When walls become words

questions.q: Do you have the video for the Chicago Interview?
questions.help: The page showed an internal note ("Video pending upload"), which we have hidden for now.
options: Not yet, keep the page without video

questions.help: We kept them exactly as written on the old site. Edit any that should change, or leave them as they are.

questions.q: What are the websites for these two galleries?
questions.help: Their "Visit gallery website" buttons are hidden until we have an address.

questions.q: What should the Petley Jones page say?
questions.help: Its description was placeholder text ("hhh"), so the section is hidden for now. A few sentences about the gallery and your work with them is perfect.

questions.q: Does Boky have a Wikipedia page?
questions.help: The footer had a Wikipedia link for Boky that went nowhere, so we removed it.

questions.q: Which email address should receive messages from the contact form?
questions.help: We will connect the form so messages arrive in this inbox directly. Until then, the form opens the visitor's own email app.

questions.q: Should we make some of the small grey text easier to read?
questions.help: A few small labels and captions are light grey on grey, as on the old site. Slightly darker text would read better, especially on phones.
options: No, keep the colours exactly as they are

questions.q: Wide artworks in tall cards: show the whole piece, or fill the card?
questions.help: A few wide pieces (like In Lucem and Figurative Poetry) sit in the middle of a tall card with their backdrop colour around them, so nothing is cut. Filling the card would crop the sides of the piece.
options: Fill the card, a little cropping is fine

questions.help: Photos, texts, a PDF or anything that answers the questions above. Up to three files, 10 MB in total.

questions.q: Anything else you would like changed?
questions.help: Open the new site and note anything here, with the page if you can.
